register.labelZh: LAUGH 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: laugh at a joke 表示因笑話有趣而笑;laugh at a person 則可以表示不友善地取笑某人。；laugh at yourself 可以表示你不會因小錯誤而感到過分尷尬或不快。；laugh something off 可以描述某人不把批評、傳聞、錯誤或尷尬情況當作重要事情。；這些表達常用於描述人們如何回應笑話、錯誤、批評、傳聞和尷尬情況。
register.summaryEn: Laugh at a joke describes enjoying something funny, while laugh at a person can describe unkindly making fun of someone. Laugh at yourself can show that you do not become too embarrassed or upset by a small mistake. Laugh something off can describe someone treating criticism, rumours, mistakes or embarrassing moments as unimportant. These expressions often appear when people respond to jokes, mistakes, criticism, rumours and embarrassing situations.
